canonical_summary: Wheat is a crop that can be grown after vetch; the field must be well fertilized before wheat harvest. Wheat was largely destroyed by drought in 1832 and has almost certain chances of income in Paris. To obtain good harvest from clearing land, ploughing deeply for second wheat brings amended soil to the surface. For terre-fort wheat, wait until soil is well soaked or pass a heavy roller over sown wheat in spring.
